content.title: About
content.content: The Balance Original Nutrition Bar is a balanced protein snack designed to support energy and recovery after workouts. It provides 20 g of protein, complex carbs, fiber, and a blend of vitamins and minerals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bar is made from plant‑based pea and rice proteins, free from dairy.
It contains a mix of nuts, seeds, and dried fruit for natural sweetness without artificial sweeteners.
Each bar is packaged in a compostable wrapper that can be recycled at home.
Balance Original has been clinically tested for maintaining stable blood glucose after intense exercise.
The product is gluten‑free and soy‑lecithin‑free, suitable for those with sensitivities.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: 20 g of protein per serving helps muscle repair and keeps you feeling full.

items.title: Complex carbs and fiber
items.content: Oat flakes and inulin provide slow‑release energy and support digestive health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B6 and B12 aid protein and carbohydrate metabolism and support the nervous system.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Calcium, magnesium and iron contribute to bone health and oxygen transport in the blood.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: The bar does not cause rapid blood‑sugar spikes, making it suitable for athletes and those monitoring glucose levels.

items.title: Nut and seed allergy
items.content: The bar contains almonds, cashews and sunflower seeds, which may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Calorie density
items.content: One bar contains about 250 kcal; consider total daily intake if you are watching calories.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although the sugar comes from natural fruit, people with diabetes should monitor consumption.

items.title: High fiber amount
items.content: Large amounts of fiber may cause gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals if consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar is convenient to take to the gym, work, or a hike. Eat it as a standalone snack or pair it with yogurt, fruit, or a protein shake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 30 days.
